% generated by experiments/e2_ground_truth.py
Rejection rates of the relative tests (W-critic base) with Wilson 95\% intervals, 200 valid replications per cell; independent windows. Anchored: permutation of the $G$/$R_{\rm past}$ evaluation labels with the critic fixed (exact at $\mathrm{Law}(G)=\mathrm{Law}(R_{\rm past})$). Two-critic: centred paired bootstrap (anti-conservative at that boundary).
Resample rows: $G$ is an i.i.d. resample of the $R_{\rm past}$ windows (the same $G$ in both rows). Split by source: every copy is on the train/eval side of its source window, so no evaluation window of $G$ was seen in training (the test is then conservative). Random split: evaluation copies of windows the critic saw as training negatives make $G$ look less like $R_{\rm new}$ than $R_{\rm past}$ does (train/eval leakage); this row is not a size.
